description: This header file defines functions related to broadcasting communication events within a system. It declares functions for starting and stopping the event producer, broadcasting specific events such as online status changes, activation state changes, and media uploads, and includes necessary external headers.

methods.name: startCommEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the communication event producer system.

methods.name: stopCommEventProducer
methods.description: Shuts down the communication event producer system.

methods.name: broadcastCommOnlineChangedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event indicating that communication online status has changed.

methods.name: broadcastCloudAssociationEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event related to cloud association state changes.

methods.name: broadcastMediaUploadedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a notification that media has been uploaded to the system.
